fields.label: Version
fields.description: Goes up when the text is edited after someone has signed it; signed copies keep the text they signed.

fields.label: Required
fields.options:
Optional
Required by item
Required for every sale
fields.description: Required by item applies to a counter sale of an Item or Item Group that names this agreement. Required for every sale blocks every counter sale until it is signed, so a walk-in sale needs a named customer.

fields.label: Signed
fields.options:
Per customer
Each firearm sold
Per document
fields.description: Per document agreements are signed from a record, such as a gunsmith work order, and never asked for at a sale.
